raw_text: NEW DELHI: An AI-generated image depicting Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping in a warm handshake went viral on social media and WhatsApp during the G20 Leaders' Summit in New Delhi. The Press Information Bureau has clarified that the image is not from any official event and is synthetically generated. While the two leaders did hold a bilateral meeting on the sidelines of the G20 summit, the actual interaction was described by diplomatic sources as formal and businesslike. The fake image was forwarded millions of times on WhatsApp before fact-checkers could flag it, raising concerns about AI-generated misinformation during high-profile diplomatic events.
